name: OpenClaw Mesh
description: P2P project file sharing between OpenClaw nodes — a local offline GitHub

nodeName.description: Unique name for this mesh node

trackDir.description: Directory to track and sync with peers

ignorePatterns.description: Additional regex patterns for files and directories the file watcher should ignore

capabilities.description: Flat capability tags advertised to mesh peers, such as has:xcode or can:ios-build

internetMode.description: Enable internet connectivity through a relay. Use hybrid to keep LAN discovery and relay together.

relayUrl.description: WebSocket URL for the mesh relay, such as wss://relay.example.com

relayRoom.description: Shared relay room name for peers that should see each other

relayToken.description: Optional shared token required by the relay server
